Students study biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology and genetic engineering alongside bioprocess engineering, fermentation technology, downstream processing, bioinformatics and engineering mathematics, with substantial laboratory work and an industry or research project. It is usually a four-year programme entered after secondary school with physics, chemistry and mathematics or biology. Graduates work in biopharmaceutical, food, agricultural and environmental biotechnology or continue to M.Tech or research study.

universities.name: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy
universities.summary: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) is a private deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956, conferred deemed status in 2001, at Tirumalaisamudram, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, with campuses at Kumbakonam and Chennai. It teaches engineering, management, law, sciences, humanities and education in English and awards its own degrees.
universities.campusLifestyle: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) reported 11,759 students across all programmes and years in its NIRF 2026 data, 13 of them from outside India. The Thanjavur central library, Saraswathi Sadan, covers about 4,340 sq m and holds 1,56,400 print books and over 1,85,757 e-books, with full-text access to about 22,950 journals. The campus has an in-house 10-bed hospital, Vaidyanatha Arogyasala.
universities.cityProfile: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) has its main campus at Tirumalaisamudram, Thanjavur (PIN 613 401), in the Cauvery delta of Tamil Nadu. Its off-campus Srinivasa Ramanujan Centre is in Kumbakonam (PIN 612 001), and its Chennai campus is at No. 21, A V Meiyappan Salai, Arcot Road, Vadapalani (behind AVM Theatre), close to the Vadapalani bus stand and Metro. SASTRA runs chargeable university buses from Thanjavur, Trichy, Kumbakonam and Pattukottai. SASTRA's admission guidance says students at Kumbakonam and Chennai use private accommodation; the Chennai campus provides documentation support for paid housing nearby.
universities.practicalExposure: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA)'s NIRF 2026 data reports that 1,499 of the 1,726 students who completed its four-year undergraduate programmes in 2024-25 were placed, at a median salary of INR 8,00,000 a year, and 162 went on to higher studies. On two-year postgraduate programmes, 304 of 417 graduates in 2024-25 were placed at a median of INR 4,00,000 a year. B.Tech students outside computing can add a minor such as AI/ML, Cybersecurity & IoT or Robotics & Automation at no extra fee. The B.Optom. and M.Optom. run in collaboration with Dr. Agarwal's Institute of Optometry, the Chennai M.Sc. Data Science carries an AI specialisation with Zoho Corp, and the B.Sc. Electronics Manufacturing is offered with Tata Electronics.
universities.hostelOverview: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) has 9 boys' and 6 girls' hostels at Thanjavur for over 4,000 men and 2,400 women. The published lodging fee runs from INR 16,000 for a non-AC 3-in-1 room to INR 90,000 for an AC single room with attached bath; first-year students get shared rooms, and single to 4-in-1 rooms open from the second year. Food is charged at actual cost, about INR 4,000 a month in SASTRA's 2025 guidance. Hostel rooms have 1 Gbps Wi-Fi.
universities.dietarySupport: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) serves only vegetarian food in its Thanjavur hostels, cooked with steam-cooking facilities. Menus include North Indian dishes as well as South Indian meals. Meals are charged at actual cost, about INR 4,000 a month in SASTRA's 2025 admission guidance, and a photo ID card is needed to obtain meals.
universities.safetyOverview: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA)'s Public Safety Office in the Thanjavur Student Center is staffed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Hostel residences have a single public entrance, and other exits are locked from inside and alarmed. Every student carries a photo ID card at all times.
universities.studentSupport: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA)'s 10-bed hospital, Vaidyanatha Arogyasala, has two full-time doctors and a resident doctor, and campus consultations are free for students. NRI applicants have a dedicated admissions line (+91 4362 350016, nriadmissions@sastra.ac.in), open 08:45 a.m. to 05:15 p.m. except Sundays and public holidays.
whyChoose: NRI-sponsored applicants can enter 26 Thanjavur B.Tech programmes at USD 5,000 a year in tuition, with no SASTRA entrance test and seats allotted first come, first served (2026 rules).
JEE Main is optional for SASTRA's B.Tech: half the merit seats are ranked on Class XII marks alone and half on Class XII plus JEE Main (2025 rules).
SASTRA's NIRF 2026 data reports 1,499 of 1,726 four-year undergraduate graduates of 2024-25 placed, at a median salary of INR 8,00,000 a year.
thingsToConsider: SASTRA's only published international route is the NRI-Sponsored category for Thanjavur B.Tech and integrated law; it publishes no route or fee for foreign nationals or for its other programmes.
Tuition for B.Tech, integrated M.Tech and B.Optom. rises 5% a year from the second year, on top of one-time development and admission fees of up to INR 16,000.
Applications are made separately for each campus and SASTRA does not allow transfers between campuses; students at Kumbakonam and Chennai use private accommodation.
bestFitFor: Children or relatives of Indians working abroad who want a Thanjavur B.Tech through the NRI-Sponsored category, sponsored by a parent or blood relative.
Indian Class XII students without a strong JEE Main score, since half of SASTRA's B.Tech merit seats are ranked on Class XII marks alone.
GATE-qualified engineering graduates, who receive a 50% M.Tech tuition waiver and a stipend listed at INR 12,400 a month.

faq.question: Is SASTRA University UGC approved?
faq.answer: Yes. Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) is a deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956, and the UGC's list of universities records it with the date 26 April 2001. It awards its own degrees at its Thanjavur, Kumbakonam and Chennai campuses.

faq.question: Is SASTRA private or government?
faq.answer: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) is a private deemed-to-be university. Its public disclosure states that it is not under the grant-in-aid scheme of the central or state government. It began in 1984 as an engineering college at Thanjavur.

faq.question: What is the B.Tech fee at SASTRA?
faq.answer: For 2026 admissions, Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) charges B.Tech tuition of INR 85,000 per semester (INR 1,70,000 a year), rising 5% a year from the second year, plus INR 1,000 a year for sports and tests and one-time fees of INR 16,000. NRI-Sponsored students pay USD 5,000 a year in tuition. Hostel and food are extra.

faq.question: Does SASTRA admit NRI and international students?
faq.answer: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) admits NRI-sponsored students to its Thanjavur B.Tech and five-year law programmes. For 2026 the sponsor had to be a parent or blood relative abroad, B.Tech applicants needed 75% in Class XII and 60% in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, and there was no entrance test. SASTRA publishes no separate route for foreign nationals.

faq.question: Which entrance exam does SASTRA use?
faq.answer: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) does not require JEE Main for B.Tech: under its 2025 rules, half the merit seats are ranked on Class XII plus JEE Main and half on Class XII alone. It prefers GATE for M.Tech, uses CAT, XAT, CMAT and similar scores for the MBA, runs its own MCA entrance exam, and uses CUET where available for other undergraduate programmes.

faq.question: What is the medium of instruction at SASTRA?
faq.answer: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) teaches in English. Its Registrar and Controller of Examinations certify English as the medium of instruction for all its degree programmes, from B.Tech and B.Com. to M.Sc., MBA, M.Optom. and Ph.D.

faq.question: What campuses does SASTRA have?
faq.answer: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) has its main campus at Tirumalaisamudram, Thanjavur, an off-campus Srinivasa Ramanujan Centre at Kumbakonam that teaches B.Tech (CSE and ECE), commerce, science and management, and a Chennai campus at Vadapalani that teaches commerce, economics, MBA and data science. Each campus needs a separate application.

faq.question: How much is the hostel fee at SASTRA?
faq.answer: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA)'s Thanjavur hostel lodging fee ranges from INR 16,000 for a non-AC 3-in-1 room to INR 90,000 for an AC single room with attached bath. Food is extra, about INR 4,000 a month in SASTRA's 2025 guidance, and all hostel meals are vegetarian. Kumbakonam and Chennai students use private accommodation.

faq.question: Is SASTRA a recognised research organisation?
faq.answer: Yes. Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) is listed by India's Department of Scientific and Industrial Research as a recognised Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO), registration 11/428/2003-TU-V, with recognition valid to 31 March 2027.

eligibility.intro: SASTRA admits to this B.Tech through merit admission on Class XII marks (JEE Main optional) and through a separate NRI-Sponsored category with its own academic thresholds.
items: Class XII pass with Mathematics and Physics plus Chemistry, Biotechnology, Computer Science or Biology, with at least 60% aggregate in a single sitting (SASTRA 2025 rules)
Mathematics in Class XII is required for this branch; non-Mathematics applicants may apply only to Biotechnology, Bioinformatics and Bioengineering
Half the merit seats are ranked on Class XII plus JEE Main (equal weight) and half on Class XII alone; JEE Main is optional
NRI-Sponsored category (2026): at least 75% overall in Class XII or equivalent and at least 60% aggregate in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
The NRI sponsor must be a parent or blood relative living abroad who undertakes to pay the full tuition fee
Curricula other than Indian state boards, CBSE/ICSE, Cambridge/Singapore, IB or a US high-school diploma need an AIU equivalence certificate
In the 2025 cycle, undergraduate applicants could not have completed 19 years on 1 August 2025

applicationSteps: Register on SASTRA's admissions portal (webstream.sastra.edu) with an email ID and an Indian mobile number; NRI-Sponsored applicants select the category 'NRI'
Complete the application, upload the documents and pay the online application fee (INR 650 for the NRI-Sponsored category in 2026)

Merit applicants are ranked in Stream 1 (Class XII with JEE Main) and Stream 2 (Class XII only) and called to counselling; NRI-Sponsored seats are allotted first come, first served with no entrance test
NRI-Sponsored applicants remit the first-year tuition by SWIFT transfer using details sent by SASTRA's NRI Admissions team (+91 4362 350016)

academic: Class XII (or equivalent) marksheet, when available
JEE Main score, if taken (merit route)
AIU equivalence certificate, where the curriculum requires one
application: Photocopy of the sponsor's passport (NRI-Sponsored)
Sponsorship letter to the Registrar undertaking to pay the full tuition fee (NRI-Sponsored)
Sponsor's address proof abroad, such as a recent utility bill (NRI-Sponsored)
Sponsor's employment proof: employer certificate, salary slip or contract (NRI-Sponsored)

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: SASTRA opened NRI-Sponsored B.Tech registration for 2026 on 27 March 2026. First-year B.Tech orientation for 2026-27 began on 3 August 2026 at Thanjavur; 2027 dates are not yet published.

programmes.mediumNote: SASTRA's Registrar and Controller of Examinations certify English as the medium of instruction for all its degree programmes.
programmes.feeNotes: The headline fee is SASTRA's 2026 merit-admission tuition of INR 1,70,000 a year (INR 85,000 per semester, rising 5% a year from year two). NRI-Sponsored students pay USD 5,000 a year in tuition.

teachingPhases.details: Full-time study at SASTRA's Thanjavur campus (School of Electrical & Electronics Engineering).

additionalFees.notes: SASTRA's NRI-Sponsored category tuition for B.Tech, Academic Year 2026: USD 5,000 per annum, payable by SWIFT transfer. NRI-Sponsored seats are at the Thanjavur campus only.

programmes.officialTitle: B.Tech. Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Smart Grid and Electric Vehicles)

fee.notes: SASTRA's fee structure for 2026 admissions lists Thanjavur B.Tech / M.Tech (Integrated) tuition of INR 85,000 per semester (INR 1,70,000 a year), with a 5% annual increase from the second year, plus INR 1,000 a year for sports and unit tests, a one-time development fee of INR 10,000 and one-time special, registration and medical-exam fees of INR 6,000 at admission. NRI-Sponsored students pay USD 5,000 a year in tuition (Academic Year 2026 NRI guidelines). Accommodation and food are charged separately.

eligibleAudiences: Indian applicants through SASTRA's merit admission (Class XII, optional JEE Main)
NRI-Sponsored applicants whose parent or blood relative abroad sponsors the full tuition fee
restrictions: SASTRA publishes no separate route or fee for foreign nationals; its international route is the NRI-Sponsored category
NRI-Sponsored seats are at the Thanjavur campus only and are allotted first come, first served, subject to seat availability
audienceEligibility.notes: The NRI-Sponsored category needs no SASTRA entrance test and requires 75% overall and 60% in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry in Class XII.

admissionsContent.overview: Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA) teaches the 4-year B.Tech. Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology) in English at its Thanjavur campus. Indian applicants are admitted on Class XII marks with optional JEE Main; NRI-sponsored applicants can apply in a separate category at USD 5,000 a year.

eligibility.intro: SASTRA admits to this B.Tech through merit admission on Class XII marks (JEE Main optional) and through a separate NRI-Sponsored category with its own academic thresholds.
items: Class XII pass with Mathematics and Physics plus Chemistry, Biotechnology, Computer Science or Biology, with at least 60% aggregate in a single sitting (SASTRA 2025 rules)
Mathematics in Class XII is required for this branch; non-Mathematics applicants may apply only to Biotechnology, Bioinformatics and Bioengineering
Half the merit seats are ranked on Class XII plus JEE Main (equal weight) and half on Class XII alone; JEE Main is optional
NRI-Sponsored category (2026): at least 75% overall in Class XII or equivalent and at least 60% aggregate in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
The NRI sponsor must be a parent or blood relative living abroad who undertakes to pay the full tuition fee
Curricula other than Indian state boards, CBSE/ICSE, Cambridge/Singapore, IB or a US high-school diploma need an AIU equivalence certificate
In the 2025 cycle, undergraduate applicants could not have completed 19 years on 1 August 2025

applicationSteps: Register on SASTRA's admissions portal (webstream.sastra.edu) with an email ID and an Indian mobile number; NRI-Sponsored applicants select the category 'NRI'
Complete the application, upload the documents and pay the online application fee (INR 650 for the NRI-Sponsored category in 2026)

Merit applicants are ranked in Stream 1 (Class XII with JEE Main) and Stream 2 (Class XII only) and called to counselling; NRI-Sponsored seats are allotted first come, first served with no entrance test
NRI-Sponsored applicants remit the first-year tuition by SWIFT transfer using details sent by SASTRA's NRI Admissions team (+91 4362 350016)
